title: Page 366
transc:
HA Seiberg N Orleans  Washn June 17 1865
Happy Luke Marshall for Negus Ginger tulip Hill the
assignment of revenue Paxton H B Blood now Chief
Vermont talbot Oliver Dayton Persia Pelham to the queenly
at gland with rank of Paxton & revenue Pearl
J G Chandler to the Oliver Dayton Peru Pelham
as Chief Vermont be satisfactory wiley Burglar number two


Washn June 17 1865
HA Seiberg N Orleans
Hunter Luke lewis for Negus gland tulip I have your
despatch of James tulip that of Hoffman Luke was need
here James & answered fully by whiff & mail Jones
tulip I sent Wythe Nelson Caldwell Persia Pelton Clarke steamers
specially adapted to Belgium trade Matagorda Rebecca Clyde Cossack Tonawanda
Rebecca Barton and Crescent yacht The twin screw sharper weans
and lighters Stanton Welles Foote and Porter were ordered but
though on duty on the <deletion>w</deletion> white Atlantic coast reputed certain
alteration & repairs indispensable before sailing on the long voyage
to the gulf yard Austin of them have been repaired
and sailed some time since tulip you have at Galway
the Tamaulipas Iron stern wheel bought & sent white expressly
for Belgium service yacht I regret much any inconvenience or
delay but could only send such steamers as were in 
existence and could not order the vessels to Sea until
repairs reputed necessary were made Stick There are few steamers
